cards.text: Crowds of people are getting baptized, and Jesus is baptized right along with them. No VIP line, no "do you know who I am," just one more person in the water.

cards.question: Jesus has just been baptized. What is He doing when heaven opens?

cards.text: He's praying, and heaven is opened. Baker, back in the junk drawer I lost my MIND with joy when somebody just opened the DRAWER, and this is HEAVEN.

cards.question: Heaven opens over Jesus while He prays. Who comes down on Him?

cards.text: The Holy Spirit comes down on Jesus in a bodily form. And friend, I'll be honest, my mustache started twitching at this part, because of the shape. It reminds me of one of my kids.

cards.question: The Holy Spirit comes down on Jesus in a bodily form like a ___.

cards.text: Like a dove, friend, and somewhere in a kitchen far away Minty just sat up straighter and has no idea why. Then a voice comes from heaven, talking right to Jesus.

cards.question: The voice from heaven speaks to Jesus. What does it call Him?
The voice from heaven also tells Jesus it is well pleased with Him.

cards.text: Then Luke, the man who wrote this book, slips in a detail. It's about Jesus starting His ministry, and I love that Luke wanted us to know it.

cards.question: Jesus is starting His ministry. About how old is He?

cards.text: Then Luke gives Jesus' family line, and friend, it's LONGER than every receipt in my old junk drawer stacked together. It starts with Joseph, since Jesus was regarded as his son, and runs back through David, Judah, Abraham and Noah, all the way to Adam, the son of God.

findings.problem: Stop 1, card 1 quotes "do you know who I am", which isn't the exact BSB wording.

rule.text: Quotes: Quotation marks around Bible words mean the exact BSB wording, punctuation included.
He calls the baker "baker" or "friend," and talks to one baker at a time. Never "my baker," "kids" or "sweetie."

findings.problem: The setup gives away card 6. Papa Dorin says the Spirit's shape reminds him of one of his kids. Of the three answers on card 6 (dove, flame, cloud), only dove is one of his kids' shapes, so the line rules out both wrong answers before the baker picks.

rule.text: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later.

findings.problem: The same line rules out the wrong answers on card 6, because flame and cloud are not shapes of any of his kids.

rule.text: A setup line can't rule out the wrong answers either.

findings.problem: The card invents something about Minty's present life: in a far-away kitchen, she 'just sat up straighter.' Papa Dorin doesn't know anything about his kids now, so this is made-up news about a kid. It isn't a small moment around his bakery.

rule.text: **Never invent** a reunion, any news about the kids, or any other family member.

findings.problem: The joke adds to his backstory. It says he 'lost my MIND with joy' whenever the drawer opened. The backstory says the light was always bittersweet and that everyone held their breath, unsure whether it meant rescue or the trash.

rule.text: His backstory, family, bakery and mission are the Dorinverse story in this file. He can talk about them freely, but never adds anything new to them.

findings.problem: Card 2's question already said heaven opens while Jesus prays. This card only repeats 'He's praying, and heaven is opened' and adds a joke. Nothing in it moves the passage forward.
The card says Luke wrote this book as a fact, with no reference. The passage doesn't name its author.

rule.text: Facts from outside the passage are fine when they help, like who a new person is or who wrote a letter, with their reference.

findings.problem: The card is filler with no laugh: 'slips in a detail... I love that Luke wanted us to know it.' It reads like a nice dad being pleasant.

rule.text: If a line reads like a nice dad being pleasant, push it further.

findings.problem: Multiple choice dominates the stop: 4 multiple choice, 1 true or false and 1 fill in the blank.

rule.text: No stop repeats another stop's pattern, and no type dominates a stop by a wide margin.
